name: growth-booster-second-brain
description: Growth Booster Second Brain — an Obsidian second brain for an owner-operated business that sets itself up. A resumable, phase-by-phase install (plan, install Obsidian, build the vault, connect Claude, settings, first pages, weekly routine, optional phone sync and Claude chat access), then daily open, file a note, build a page, weekly update, ask, and a monthly health check.
